title: Resonance of the Tianji Record
next_chapter_hook: At the very instant when the vortex of fate swept all three into its grasp, a familiar figure slowly emerged from the depths of the Void—Cang Yutian stood with hands clasped behind his back, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his lips, coldly observing this reunion spanning ten thousand years.

text.content:
"We are all chess pieces. I simply awakened ten thousand years earlier than you."

These words cut through Chen Ji's eardrums to his heart like an invisible blunt blade. His worldview, carefully constructed over seventeen years, collapsed completely at this moment.

The starry sky of Tianqing Sect silently gazed upon these ruins. The demonic path commander's silhouette flickered in the black mist, those fathomless eyes reflecting Chen Ji's current disheveled state—not physical disarray, but the inescapable despair deep within his soul.

Chen Ji's hands trembled slightly. He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record fragments in his embrace, those yellowed pages now quivering at an eerie frequency, as if sensing something.

"You..." His voice was hoarse, unrecognizable to himself. "What exactly are you?"

The demonic path commander offered no response. She simply stood there motionless, allowing the surrounding black mist to surge like tides. And in that moment, the Tianji Record blazed with sudden intensity—the searing sensation shot from his fingertips directly to his crown, nearly making Chen Ji cry out.

"Chen Ji!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly leapt from the first page, his voice carrying unmistakable alarm for the first time. "The Tianji Record is unfolding on its own! You must suppress it—now!"

But it was already too late.

The yellowed pages in Chen Ji's hands flipped violently, rustling loudly. The fifth page, the sixth page—originally blank pages were now visibly filling with dense arrays of runes, and the color of those runes—was black.

dialogue.content: "Impossible..." Chen Ji stared fixedly at the emerging runes, his voice carrying a tremor he himself couldn't detect. "The Tianji Record only has six pages... six pages! That's what I know, that's what Mo Xiansheng told me!"

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng fell silent.

That silence chilled Chen Ji more than any answer. He jerked his head up, staring intensely at that ethereal figure, his questioning gaze nearly solidifying: "What do you know? From the very beginning you—"

"I am but a remnant soul." Mo Xiansheng's voice was low. "What I know is only what I am permitted to know."

The Tianji Record's trembling grew increasingly violent. The runes on the fifth page had fully manifested. And in the center of those densely packed black characters, a name was slowly taking shape.

It was a character Chen Ji had never seen before, yet somehow familiar.

The strokes were ancient, as if they had existed since the dawn of creation, each stroke containing some indescribable pressure. And the moment that name fully manifested, the Tianji Record suddenly emitted a blinding light, forming an eerie resonance with the black energy surrounding the demonic path commander.

The two forces intertwined and wound in the air, like long-lost brothers probing each other. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate power draining at an alarming rate—5 points, 10 points, 15 points—and the Tianji Record showed no signs of stopping.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record was frantically absorbing Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate power, and that unfamiliar name grew increasingly clear. You must make a choice—

choices.description: Stop resisting, let the Tianji Record completely merge with that black energy. Dangerous, but perhaps you can glimpse the truth.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock Hidden Truth of Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption is enormous, may endanger life

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and actively released his suppression of the Tianji Record. In an instant, that suction force dramatically intensified, as if opening a gate sealed for ten thousand years. Excruciating pain surged from every limb and joint; he felt as though he was being torn apart—

choices.description: Use all your strength to seal the Tianji Record's power, stop the drain of Heavenly Fate. Safe, but may miss the truth.
choices.risk_hint: Force suppression may backfire on oneself

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly pressed his palms together, forcibly sealing the Tianji Record in a manner bordering on self-harm. The intense pain made him grunt, but that sensation of Heavenly Fate draining frantically finally stopped. The Tianji Record struggled in his palm a few times before gradually quieting down.

choices.description: Delay the Tianji Record's abnormalities, first forcibly extract the truth from Mo Xiansheng.
choices.risk_hint: Mr. Mo may not reveal the entire truth.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly steadying his mind. He did not let the Tianji Record run wild, nor did he forcibly suppress it. Instead, he turned his gaze to that illusory figure, his voice ice-cold: "Mr. Mo, the Tianji Record originally had seven pages—where is the seventh page?"

Mr. Mo's form trembled slightly.

This was a reaction Chen Ji had never witnessed—in ten thousand years, the guardian soul fragment that had always been in complete control, never missing a calculation, now resembled a mortal whose weakness had been exposed. He opened his mouth, and the illusory figure began to fade.

"The seventh page..." Mr. Mo's voice was hoarse, "was never separated."

"What do you mean?"

"The Tianji Record never had seven pages." Mr. Mo closed his eyes, his voice carrying an indescribable melancholy. "It only had one page. That single page was forcibly torn apart, becoming the six fragments we have now. And the part that was torn away..."

He did not finish.

But Chen Ji already understood.

He abruptly looked up, toward the Demonic Path commander who still stood motionless. Within the black mist swirling around her, he clearly sensed that familiar aura—the aura of the Tianji Record, the aura of Heavenly Fate.

dialogue.content: "So..." Chen Ji's voice was dry, each word seeming to be squeezed out of his throat, "the seventh page has always been within you."

text.content:
The Demonic Path commander finally moved.

Her form slowly stepped out from the black mist, fully exposed to the starlight for the first time. It was an exquisite face, but one that struck fear into the heart—its beauty was not human, but rather a perfection that transcended the mortal realm, approaching the very laws of heaven.

And on her brow center, a mark that perfectly matched the seventh name on the Tianji Record was slowly glowing.

"Chen Ji." Her voice was no longer the commanding pressure from before, but carried an inexplicable complexity. "We have met far more times than you remember."

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path commander's words plunged Chen Ji into deeper confusion. The resonance of the Tianji Record continued to intensify, and the Heavenly Fate power between the two began to produce a strange synchronicity. You decide—

choices.description: "We have met? When? How many times?"
choices.risk_hint: Deep resonance may expose more weaknesses

text.content: Chen Ji did not retreat. He voluntarily released the last trace of his guard, allowing the resonance to penetrate deep into his soul. In an instant, countless shattered images flooded into his mind like a tide—

choices.description: "Whatever the past holds, right now we are enemies."

text.content: Chen Ji took a step back, the shock in his eyes quickly replaced by coldness. He reorganized his expression, even allowing a trace of mockery to curl at the corner of his mouth: "What does the past have to do with the current chess game?"

choices.description: Say nothing, simply watch her quietly, waiting for her to reveal more on her own.
choices.risk_hint: Silence may be seen as weakness

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He simply stood there quietly, his gaze deep as an ancient well, without a trace of waves. That silence was more oppressive than any interrogation—he was waiting, waiting for her to speak first.

Those visions caused Chen Ji's breath to halt abruptly.

He saw a scene of a baby's birth—no, not a baby, but two. Two connected souls torn apart forcibly by the Heavenly Dao, half transforming into the fragments of the Tianji Record, the other half becoming the dormant origin within the woman before him.

And the time this scene occurred—one ten thousand years ago.

dialogue.content: 'One body, twin souls, originally the same source.' The Demonic Path commander's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, each word carrying the weight of ten thousand years. 'The Tianji Record chose you because your blood carries the same lineage as mine. And I was abandoned here...' Her voice paused slightly, 'because I was too dangerous.'

text.content:
Chen Ji felt his worldview being overturned once more.

One body, twin souls? The same bloodline? What did this mean? Did it mean that he and this Demonic Path commander...

'No.' Chen Ji abruptly cut off his own thoughts, his voice carrying a rare hint of panic. 'You're lying to me. The Tianji Record is Ancestor Chen Xuan's legacy, what does it have to do with me? What does it have to do with my ancestors?'

Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted over from beside him: 'Chen Xuan... was never the first master of the Tianji Record. It chose him only because he bore the surname Chen. And the Chen family...'

'Is the guardian of the seventh-page bloodline.' The Demonic Path commander picked up the thread. 'And also the executioner who separated us.'

Chen Ji was stunned.

The Chen family as guardian? Also as separator?

He suddenly recalled what his grandfather had told him as a child: 'Chen Ji, remember, our Chen family's mission was never to ascend to immortality, but to guard. To guard the secrets that should never be touched.'

At the time, he thought his grandfather was referring to the Tianji Record. Only now did he understand that his grandfather meant far more than that.

In the sky, two forces—the golden light of the Tianji Record and the black aura of the Demonic Path commander—were merging at a frantic speed. Chen Ji felt a resonance emerging between his own Heavenly Fate power and the other party, an experience both foreign and intimately familiar, as if he had encountered it countless times in dreams.

'Fate Vortex...' Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly tensed. 'Your resonance is too intense, drawing the attention of Heavenly Dao laws. If you don't separate soon, the entire boundary of the heavens will—'

Before the words finished, the sky abruptly changed color.

The originally pitch-black heavens suddenly cracked open a massive fissure, from which poured not light but an indescribable gray—that was the color of fate, the origin of Heavenly Dao laws.

Three silhouettes were faintly visible within that gray vortex. Chen Ji saw one blurred outline slowly taking shape, gradually revealing features he knew with absolute certainty—

choice.prompt: The Fate Vortex is forming, the third figure becoming increasingly clear. Whoever it is, this means your secrets are about to be exposed beneath the Heavenly Dao. You decide—

choices.description: Forcefully cut the connection with the Demonic Path commander, preventing the Fate Vortex from taking shape.
choices.risk_hint: Abrupt severance may cause permanent damage
choices.process_label: bite tongue, sever resonance with blood

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. He abruptly bit through his tongue, spraying refined blood onto the Tianji Record. The golden light quivered violently, and the intermingling with the black aura ceased instantly. The agony nearly made him lose consciousness, but he gritted his teeth tightly, forcefully tearing apart that connection.

choices.description: Stop resisting and face the impending judgment alongside the Demonic Path commander.
choices.visible_reward: Possible acquisition of Heavenly Dao's recognition
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Dao's will is unpredictable, outcome unknown
choices.process_label: stand with demon commander against vortex

text.content: Chen Ji did not retreat. Instead, he stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with the Demonic Path commander. 'Since the Heavenly Dao wishes to judge, then let it come.' His voice was unexpectedly calm. 'A chess game spanning ten thousand years should finally reach its conclusion.'

choices.description: The Fate Vortex requires time to take shape. Now is the moment to seek a path of escape.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength and seek another opportunity
choices.risk_hint: May be tracked by the Fate Vortex

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Though the Fate Vortex was terrifying, it surely had its own patterns of operation. He rapidly swept his gaze across the surroundings, and within that gray river of fate, he caught sight of a delicate fissure—a corner momentarily overlooked by the Heavenly Dao's will.

It was a face Chen Ji would never forget.

Sword-like brows and star-bright eyes, temperament profound as an abyss. Though seeing him for the first time, Chen Ji felt an illusion of facing his closest kin.

Cang Yutian.

That name—the one rumored to have been erased by the Heavenly Dao's Eye, the one who should have completely vanished—now stood quietly at the center of the Fate Vortex, coldly observing this farce. His gaze first fell upon the Demonic Path commander, then slowly shifted to Chen Ji's face, finally fixing on the yellowed pages of the Tianji Record.

That gaze held no hostility, no benevolence, only a detachment spanning ten thousand years—like observing two unruly children.

dialogue.content:
"Father."

The voice of the Demonic Path Commander rang out in the silence, as light as a sigh.

Chen Ji turned sharply, looking at the woman beside him. Her face held no surprise, no hatred—only a peace beyond words, as if she had long anticipated this moment.

And that word "Father" made Chen Ji's heart sink heavily.

text.content:
Chen Ji's mind raced through all the information.

One body with two souls, shared bloodline, Chen Family guardian, the abandoned seventh page—all the clues pointed toward a chilling possibility.

If the Demonic Path Commander was Cang Yutian's daughter, then he and this woman...

"Interesting." Cang Yutian's voice finally sounded, as still as an ancient well yet carrying an irresistible pressure. "The chess game I set up—and you've actually managed to reach this point."

His gaze shifted from the Demonic Path Commander and finally settled on Chen Ji's face, his lips curving slightly upward: "Especially you—the descendant of my old friend."

Chen Ji felt his heartbeat nearly stop.

A friend's descendant? Chen Xuan? Cang Yutian and Chen Xuan... were old acquaintances?

"You two..." Cang Yutian's voice echoed through the vortex, carrying the desolation of ten thousand years. "You were always two sides of the same coin. I separated you, hoping that one day you could truly control your own fate, rather than being manipulated by Heavenly Dao."

He shook his head slightly, the indifference on his face finally cracking: "Alas, I underestimated Heavenly Dao's patience. It waited ten thousand years, finally seizing the moment of your reunion."

The roaring of the Vortex of Destiny grew louder, and three silhouettes in the gray torrent became increasingly clear—besides Cang Yutian, the outlines of two other figures were slowly emerging.

dialogue.content: "So this is the truth." Chen Ji's voice was low, every word seeming to be挤出 from between his teeth. "Ten thousand years ago, you split the Tianji Record in two—one half left in the mortal realm as a book of prophecy, the other sealed within your daughter as the origin of the Demonic Path. And us... our so-called 'defying destiny' was from the very beginning within your calculations."

text.content:
Cang Yutian did not deny it.

He simply watched the two of them quietly, his eyes showing for the first time a complex emotion—a father's guilt, intermingled with a chess player's coldness.

"Calculations?" His voice was low. "No—this is the last thing I could do for you. The moment Heavenly Dao's Eye noticed you, you already had no way out. All I could do was let you live a bit longer, grow a bit stronger."

He raised his hand, pointing toward the slowly expanding Vortex of Destiny: "And now, it has come."

Chen Ji followed Cang Yutian's finger and looked.

At the deepest part of the Vortex of Destiny, a massive eye was slowly opening. That eye had no whites, no pupils—only a chaotic gray—that was the Heavenly Dao's Eye, an existence that transcended all laws.

Its gaze swept over Cang Yutian, swept over the Demonic Path Commander, and finally settled on Chen Ji.

It was a feeling of being completely seen through. Chen Ji felt that all his secrets, all his schemes, all his disguises became utterly meaningless before that eye.

And at that moment, Cang Yutian moved.

dialogue.content:
"Go."

Cang Yutian's voice contained only one word, yet carried undeniable authority. His figure suddenly expanded, blocking the way between Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander, facing that massive Heavenly Dao's Eye from afar.

"Father's remnant soul won't last much longer." The Demonic Path Commander's voice sounded beside Chen Ji's ear, rarely tinged with urgency. "He used his remaining strength to tear open a path for us to escape."

text.content:
Chen Ji grabbed the Demonic Path Commander's wrist abruptly: "Wait—what do you mean? His remnant soul?"

The Demonic Path Commander glanced at him, a flash of complex emotions passing through her eyes: "Do you think he could appear here for no reason? The real Cang Yutian died ten thousand years ago. This... is merely a wisp of obsession he left in the River of Destiny."

Chen Ji froze.

He looked at that back facing the Heavenly Dao's Eye, and suddenly remembered many things—Mo Xiansheng's silence about only knowing Cang Yutian's name, the hidden secrets in the Chen Family ancestral teachings, and the fleeting relief that flickered across Cang Yutian's face when that eye appeared.

That was not the joy of a long-awaited reunion, but the liberation of finally being able to let go.

"Chen Ji." Cang Yutian's voice drifted from the distance, carrying an unprecedented gentleness. "I owe your Chen Family an explanation, owe her a father's identity. But now, the most important thing is to let you survive."

His figure began to grow translucent, the confrontation with the Heavenly Dao's Eye consuming his final existence: "The complete form of the Tianji Record is neither within my daughter nor in the fragment in your hands. It requires you two... to become one."

Before the words finished, a blinding light burst forth from the Vortex of Destiny. Cang Yutian's figure dissolved completely, transforming into a golden thread that pierced through countless obstacles, landing precisely in Chen Ji's palm within the Tianji Record.

The sixth page—the originally blank sixth page—finally revealed its true content at this moment.

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the Tianji Record in his hand.

The content on the sixth page was merely a few lines, yet it made his pupils contract sharply:

"Heavenly fate converges, twin souls born from one source. The seventh page serves as the guide, the sixth page serves as the reliance. Uniting both may shatter the Eye of Heaven."

And below those words, a symbol Chen Ji had never seen before was slowly emerging—the final seal of the Tianji Record, and also the key to unlocking the complete power of Heavenly Secrets.

The Demonic Path Commander's hand gently covered the back of Chen Ji's hand, and the Heavenly Fate power of both at this moment thoroughly merged. The Tianji Record burst forth with unprecedented light, simultaneously enveloping both of them.

And that Heavenly Dao's Eye, at this moment, finally fully opened its pupil—reflected within it was precisely the merged form of Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander.

At this critical moment, a crack suddenly appeared at the edge of the Vortex of Destiny.

A familiar figure walked out from the Void, hands clasped behind his back, a meaningful smile playing at the corners of his mouth. He wore the长老 robes of the Tianqing Sect, his features handsome, yet his eyes were cold as eternal ice.

Ling Yuan.

His gaze swept over Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander who were merging, swept over the approaching Heavenly Dao's Eye, and finally settled on the glorious Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hand.

"What a magnificent reunion." His voice echoed in the roar, carrying a chilling satisfaction. "Unfortunately, the ending of this play shall not be written by you."

Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. The fusion between him and the Demonic Path Commander had just begun, the power of the Tianji Record had not yet fully awakened, and Ling Yuan... was clearly well-prepared.
